title: AfterDark module.json
description: Manifest for an AfterDark recreation-suite module. Drives the catalog and the per-module config UI on every platform.

id.description: Stable slug, must match ModuleInfo.id in code.

version.description: Module semver, independent of the suite version.

category.description: ambient = classic eye candy; interactive = playable/game-style.

assets.description: Relative paths to sprites/audio/fonts bundled with the module.

settings.description: Declarative settings; the host renders these into the config UI on Windows and macOS from this one declaration.
